text: Ectoplasm [Gr. ektoV , outside + plasma , substance]: Ger. Ektoplasma ; Fr. ectoplasme ; Ital. ectoplasma . The outer layer of the protoplasm of certain animal and vegetable cells. Long recognized in certain unicellular organisms, and termed ectosarc. The observation has been extended to the tissue cells of higher animals and plants. Literature : C. KUPFFER, Ueber Differenzierung des Protoplasma an den Zellen thierischer Gewebe., Zeitsch. naturw. Ver. Schles.- Holst. (1875); O. HERTWIG, The Cell (trans., 1895). ( C.LL.M. )
